title: Resolving a Conflict
objective: Resolve a heading conflict, stage the file, finish the merge, and print the result and a clean status.
hint: Set up the two conflicting headings and run the merge with *> $null. Then Set-Content for # Notes from both, git add README.md, and git commit -q -m "Resolve heading conflict". Then Get-Content, and an if line with -not (git status --short) that prints Status: clean.
